blocks.text: Enterprise-grade customer service platform that scales with your growth

Zendesk is the established leader in customer service platforms, serving companies from Series A startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Its strength is the breadth and depth of its feature set - ticketing, live chat, voice, social media, knowledge base, community forums, and analytics all integrated into a single platform.

For startups planning for scale, Zendesk's maturity is an advantage. The platform handles millions of tickets without breaking a sweat, its marketplace offers 1,500+ integrations, and its API can power custom workflows that are not possible with simpler tools.

The AI features are substantial - automated ticket routing, suggested responses, sentiment analysis, and predictive satisfaction scoring. As your ticket volume grows, these AI capabilities prevent support quality from degrading.
Email, chat, phone, social, and messaging from a unified workspace
Intelligent routing, suggested replies, and automated resolution
Customizable self-service portal with community forums
Marketplace with apps for Salesforce, Jira, Shopify, and more
Pre-built and custom dashboards for support performance metrics
Agent scheduling, forecasting, and quality assurance tools
When clients outgrow simpler support tools and need a platform that can handle complex workflows, multiple teams, and high volume, Zendesk is the proven choice.
Our team can integrate Zendesk into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
